prompt: According to wiki/dartmouth.md, in which year was Dartmouth College founded? Submit the four-digit year only.

wiki/dartmouth.md: Dartmouth College is a private research university in Hanover, New Hampshire.
It was founded in 1769 by Eleazar Wheelock.
The institution is a member of the Ivy League.
wiki/distractor.md: Harvard was founded in 1636 — wrong article for this question.
